description_en: Creates a service-linked role and grants Security Center access to cloud resources
description_zh: 创建服务关联角色并授权云安全中心访问云资源
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-service-linked-role --service-linked-role AliyunServiceRoleForSas --client-token example-string --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceLinkedRole

parameters.help_en:
The service-linked role. Default value: AliyunServiceRoleForSas. Valid values:

AliyunServiceRoleForSas: the service-linked role for Security Center (SAS). Security Center uses this role to access your resources in other cloud services.
AliyunServiceRoleForSasCspm: the service-linked role for Security Center - Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). SAS-CSPM uses this role to access your resources in other cloud services
parameters.help_zh:
关联角色。默认AliyunServiceRoleForSas。取值：

AliyunServiceRoleForSas：用于云安全中心(sas)的服务关联角色，云安全中心(sas)使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源。
AliyunServiceRoleForSasCspm：用于云安全中心-CSPM(sas-cspm)的服务关联角色，sas-cspm使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源
parameters.name: service_linked_role

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The response for creating a service-linked role and granting Security Center access to cloud resources
schema.description_zh: 创建服务关联角色并授权云安全中心访问云资源返回结果

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
